==== aboard init --harness claude-code ====
claude-code, everywhere:
  create    ~/.claude/skills/aboard/SKILL.md (skill)
  create    ~/.claude/settings.json (hooks)
            SessionStart: ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook claude-code session-start
            UserPromptSubmit: ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook claude-code prompt
            PostToolUse: ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook claude-code tool
            SessionEnd: ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook claude-code end
            (Claude Code 2.0.50 doesn't run Stop and PreToolUse; aboard doctor says what that leaves out)
codex: not chosen
omp: not found on this machine
Run aboard init --yes --harness claude-code to make these changes.

==== aboard init --yes --harness claude-code (again) ====
claude-code, everywhere:
  unchanged ~/.claude/skills/aboard/SKILL.md (skill)
  unchanged ~/.claude/settings.json (hooks)
codex: not chosen
omp: not found on this machine
Nothing to change.
==== file .claude/settings.json ====
{
  "hooks": {
    "SessionStart": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook claude-code session-start",
            "timeout": 30
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "UserPromptSubmit": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook claude-code prompt",
            "timeout": 10
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "PostToolUse": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook claude-code tool",
            "timeout": 10
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "SessionEnd": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "ABOARD_HOME={ABOARD_HOME} {ABOARD} hook claude-code end",
            "timeout": 10
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
==== file .claude/skills/aboard/SKILL.md ====
(the Aboard skill this aboard installs, byte for byte)
==== install manifest ====
{
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "{HOME}/.claude/skills/aboard/SKILL.md",
      "harness": "claude-code",
      "scope": "global",
      "kind": "skill",
      "version": "{version}",
      "commit": "{commit}",
      "sha256": "{sha256}",
      "created": true
    },
    {
      "path": "{HOME}/.claude/settings.json",
      "harness": "claude-code",
      "scope": "global",
      "kind": "hooks",
      "version": "{version}",
      "commit": "{commit}",
      "sha256": "{sha256}",
      "created": true
    }
  ]
}
